name: 前门传统美食区
experience_value: Lets first-visit food experiences stay connected to the city's symbolic core instead of feeling geographically detached.
Works as a bridge between historic sightseeing and edible memory, especially for student and couple samples.
Useful when Beijing food should read as continuity with route history, not just as a separate detour.
avoid_when: the itinerary is explicitly avoiding high-traffic classic first-visit zones
the route already leans too heavily on Qianmen and needs another district identity
the traveler wants deep neighborhood food texture rather than high-recognition old-city food logic
